rig.name: Earth, Wind & Fire - Boogie Wonderland - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight funk rhythm.
Achieve tight, consistent attack and punch required for funk rhythm playing.
Provide a clean, bright edge and slight grit boost without adding heavy saturation.
Add subtle width and movement to the clean tone, as suggested by the source material.
blocks.gap: The original funk sound might prefer a Phaser or Tremolo for bite, but Chorus provides necessary stereo lift.

blocks.purpose: The core signature element: rhythmic wah sweep for lead and rhythm accents.
Simulate the clean, bright Fender-style amp required for disco/funk tones.
Provide a bright, articulate cabinet sound that complements the clean US Deluxe tone.
blocks.gap: While the source suggests Fender/American tones, using UK Vintage 4x12 provides necessary high-end clarity and punch for funk.

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the frequency response, emphasizing high mids and highs for 'bite' and clarity.
Add rhythmic depth and space to the funky lead lines.
Provide a subtle sense of space without muddying the tight funk rhythm.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by switching from a UK-voiced IR to a more American/Fender-style voicing.

proposals.reason: The tone is clean and US-based; the UK IR clashes with the desired American funk sound.
